description: Proves the PMail runtime is running in an attested TEE environment

judges.description: TRUE if hardware-signed attestation blob matches claimed workload, QP verifier, and privacy policy hashes

critical_rules: TEE attestation proves execution isolation, NOT network anonymity
An attested runtime can still leak metadata via network
Attestation blob must be verified against hardware root of trust
Non-TEE environment => this claim cannot be satisfied
